expected_structural_delta: One existing test file. Zero production owners, modules, dependencies or contracts.
minimum_design: Close the watcher after initialization and deliver bounded event batches to the existing real handler. Retain filesystem integration tests and all read-cost and outcome assertions.
outcome: Notification load tests measure fixed event workloads without relying on OS watcher event counts.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing notification test boundary
reuse_decisions.rationale: The broadcast tests already close the real watcher after hydration. The load test already instruments handleNotificationEvent and retains real files, counts, reads and subscriptions.
